statusLegend.OPEN: Finding requires remediation before release criteria can pass.
statusLegend.IN_PROGRESS: Work has started, but closure evidence is incomplete.
statusLegend.BLOCKED: Remediation blocked by dependency; mitigation and owner required.
statusLegend.DONE: Code and evidence complete; closure criteria met.

findings.title: Document OCR jobs use UNCONFIGURED provider in upload path
closureCriteria: Upload path selects a real provider strategy or returns explicit DISABLED capability result.
No production code path persists provider=UNCONFIGURED OCR jobs.
Automated tests cover enabled and disabled OCR paths.

findings.title: Chat tool dispatch has generic unimplemented fallback
closureCriteria: Tool dispatch uses explicit typed allowlist for all executable tools.
Unsupported tool names emit structured telemetry and user-safe fallback.
Contract tests verify behavior for supported/unsupported tool calls.
findings.closureNotes: TOOL_EXECUTION_KIND is an exhaustive compile-time allowlist (read | mutation | inline); the read handler map is typed Record<ReadToolName, ToolHandler>. Unknown names are rejected by parseToolArguments (ToolPolicyError). A classified tool without an executor now writes an ai_tool_unsupported activity-log entry and returns a user-safe message.

findings.title: Billing cancellation endpoint mutates local state without provider handshake
closureCriteria: Cancellation endpoint performs provider-side cancellation or queues it transactionally.
Local subscription state transitions are idempotent and reconciled against provider source-of-truth.
Tests cover retry and already-cancelled scenarios.
findings.closureNotes: Cancellation is provider-confirmed (Stripe/Razorpay ownership verified, cycle-end cancel) or scheduled as prepaid expiry; no local downgrade happens without confirmation. Local state is idempotent (alreadyScheduled) and tests cover retry, provider-already-scheduled and provider-failure paths.

findings.title: Broken internal links from dashboard/reseller flows
closureCriteria: Audited links resolve to valid internal pages.
Automated regression test asserts route targets map to existing pages.
Deterministic route/link audit report generated in CI.
findings.closureNotes: Audit reports 0 broken internal routes. Added /access-denied; document links point at /documents; the audit now recognises route.ts handlers and next.config redirects and ignores crawler/framework path literals. The test runs the audit and fails on any broken route (GATE-003).

findings.title: Material any/type-safety debt in critical paths
closureCriteria: Critical-path modules maintain explicit interfaces for API payloads.
Per-release explicit-any budget is tracked and ratcheted down.
Lint baseline and non-regression checks are enforced.
